text:
tayla: Opening a small docs PR to unify wording around rate limits/quotas and to fix two bad dashboard deep-links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/433

ben: Which files?

tayla: pricing/rate-limits.md, usage/metering.md, integrations/sdk-snippets.md and a brief note on pricing/tiers.md about quota resets.

abby: The old JS snippet uses `client.generate()`; need to switch to `client.text.generate()` and show streaming iterator. I'll update JS and Python.

linkbot: Link check: metering.md -> broken external /billing/faq. Also internal anchor #quota-behavior 404s.

ron: For the dashboard links the panel param changed to `panel_id=tm_v2`. I'll update URLs in metering.md.

tayla: Add a short example of burst behavior: "Brief spikes under 60s may be allowed by minute-level burst buckets; sustained exceedance gets throttled."

abby: Also added a billing note: "Metering rounds up to 10-token buckets; billing reflects rounded usage." Small code comment added about REDWOOD_API_KEY env var.

docs-eng: Quick nit: use metric name `token_minutes` on the tier page to match Grafana. Also explicitly state quota resets at 00:00 UTC.

ben: LGTM. Can someone squash the lint warnings? CI flagged missing language tag on code fences.

abby: Fixed fences and pushed commit. Linkbot rechecked: no remaining internal 404s. CI passing.

linkbot: PR #433 merged by tayla 1: docs rebuild queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/100112

tayla: Thanks team 7: will add a short changelog line and ping support about the billing rounding example.
